cards.name: Deku Stick
cards.text: Lights torches, revealing enemies in that square.

cards.name: Ice Arrow
cards.text: Extinguishes rings of flame, unlocking a secret reward.

cards.name: Bomb
cards.text: Opens cave entrances in mountain walls and destroys boulders on land, unlocking a secret reward or revealing enemies in that square.

cards.name: Giant
cards.text: Use all four on the square with the clock tower to unlock a hidden part of the map.

cards.name: Goron Mask
cards.text: Weighs down switches, revealing enemies in that square.

cards.name: Inverted Song of Time
cards.text: Gives 10 extra hours before the Moon crashes, resetting the map.

cards.name: Compass
cards.text: Reveals all secrets within a battle square, making their tiles sparkle.

cards.name: Deku Mask
cards.text: Fly across large gaps using flowers, removing locks on certain adjacent squares so that they can be opened normally.

cards.name: Zora Mask
cards.text: Stops whirlpools, revealing enemies in that square.

cards.name: Mask of Truth
cards.text: Temporarily doubles a Warrior's defense for a stage.

cards.name: Majora's Mask
cards.text: Maxes out a Warrior's Special and Magic gauges for a stage.

cards.name: Song of Time
cards.text: Resets the map without having to wait for the Moon to crash and restores the time restriction of the Moon if the final battle square had been completed.
